vehicle_writer: any account that can write to the site build driver's stderr stream — site-build runs under the submitting user and echoes advisories from its shared configuration
write_precondition: site-build reads advisory text from a shared configuration under /opt/site and echoes it into the build log; a user with write access to that configuration can change what appears there
